currentParagraphText: “Are you saying you also struggled to understand concepts?” Jake asked her.

finalResult.nextParagraphText: “I don’t think comparing our situations makes much sense,” Artemis shook her head. “You already far surpass anything I had accomplished when at your level. That includes my comprehension of concepts. You may think you’re bad at it, but that’s only because you’re trying to understand concepts that someone of your level shouldn’t even be touching upon. And if they did, it would be in a school of magic you were highly specialized in.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: Artemis just smiled and shook her head. “Seeing is understanding, as the saying goes. When one becomes able to perceive concepts, one also becomes able to analyze and try to understand them. Form one’s own concept from another’s. Someone like the Void Mechanist does this through study and a high level of intellect that can’t truly be copied. However, for people like you and I, that isn’t gonna happen.”
